auditor: paper_audit agent; implementation author, separate read-only evidence analysis; not external third-party certification
claims_not_established: An analytic physical cell causes a task utility advantage over ordinary physics.
The 8 midtrajectory sampled frontiers demonstrate a correctness gain from READ.
The finite exported Q-table deploys a general native neural controller or generalizes beyond enumerated public states.
576 independent task samples, optimized hardware efficiency, energy savings, full He-Xiong continuum equivalence, general multimodal/foundation-model superiority, or arbitrary-crash exactly-once.
claims_supported: The fresh native implementation executes the declared finite task before content reads and matches the Python public-state/cost contract.
Read-capable policies genuinely change final correctness relative to initial STOP for some of the same private worlds; paired counts above distinguish improvements and harms.
Native checkpoint cloning, task ledger persistence and acknowledged clean restart work for the tested paths.
derivation: Only original evidence files were read. This JSON is the sole new output; no raw evidence was edited, no worlds were selected or added, and no native experiment was rerun.

main_sample.inference_unit: Same (case, seed) means the same private truth, future votes, and failure realization across all policy/family arms. 576 executions are 48 paired worlds, not 576 independent samples. Generalization over tasks also has only 8 configurations.

measurement_scope.campaign_cpu: REPORT campaign_parent_cpu_seconds excludes child CPU. Do not call it total campaign CPU or add it to run_cpu_seconds without removing duplicate parent intervals.
measurement_scope.counterfactual_fields: task_cost/utility are continuation values after subtracting prefix paid_cost; original clock/reads remain cumulative. Audit adds continuation_ticks and continuation_attempted_reads.
measurement_scope.inner_metrics: R9 inner timing and byte counters exclude R10 composite intent/checkpoint overhead; whole process measurements include this overhead.
measurement_scope.peak_child_rss_kib: Whole launched child process peak RSS, not an incremental Rust-only working set.
measurement_scope.reads: Consumed read attempts, including charged failures; not the number of successful decodes.
measurement_scope.run_cpu_seconds: Parent validation/process-control CPU within run_owner plus all child user/system CPU returned by wait4, including binary startup, config/model loading, native execution and task persistence.
measurement_scope.run_wall_seconds: Process launch through close plus within-run validation. Excludes preparing model JSON, public Q tables, payload templates, checkpoint cloning, compilation and previous head training.
measurement_scope.task_cost: Declared finite-task action cost, not measured energy or CPU.

midtrajectory_counterfactuals.interpretation: All 8 recorded full native frontiers are cloned into 3 requested branches. Only 2 frontiers allow all 3 actions. Six illegal READ requests become STOP with invalid cost and no content access. All branches at each frontier have the same final answer and correctness in this realized sample; their utility differences are cost differences. This does not show that conditional expected information value is universally zero.

no_future_leakage_review.counterfactual_worlds: The same pre-generated private world is retained across cloned branches. No branch selects its first action from that world; requested actions are the fixed enumeration READ, WAIT, STOP.
no_future_leakage_review.implementation_review: Policy::decision receives public Config/State only. A legal actual READ is chosen before payload I/O. Payload paths/hashes and realized worlds are not policy features. Python execute accesses world votes/failures only after the public legality guard.
no_future_leakage_review.qualification_limit: This is code-path and receipt review, not an adversarial information-flow proof. Reliability/failure rates are declared synthetic task parameters; two actual FullHX packets encode the calibrated 0/1 observations.

physical_family_control.interpretation: Switching ordinary/distribution physics while keeping the public Q-table policy fixed changes no task state, answer, quality, read count, clock or task utility in these runs. READ is selected from the public task table; latent CTMC firing does not cause a READ. This experiment establishes no causal utility gain from the physical family.

restart_check.scope: Acknowledged clean shutdown/restart; not arbitrary-crash exactly-once.
